title: Rank Within Each Department
learning_objective: Learn how PARTITION BY restarts ranking inside each department.

tutorial.explanation: PARTITION BY divides the result into independent ranking groups. For department salary questions, each department gets its own rank 1, 2, 3...
tutorial.syntax: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC)
tutorial.mental_model: PARTITION BY is like running the same ranking query separately for each department.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT d.department_name, e.employee_name, e.salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.department_name ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees e INNER JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;
guided_example.explanation: The rank restarts for each department_name partition.

practice.prompt: Return department_name, employee_name, and salary_rank within each department.
practice.expected_query: SELECT d.department_name, e.employee_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.department_name ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees e INNER JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;

hints: Order each partition by salary DESC.
